lines.369680624298569728: That's the spirit. Well, I wish you the best. It's been nice chatting.
lines.369680624302764032: In case I don't see you again, good luck to you. I truly hope you'll find what you're looking for.
lines.369680624315346944: I just got here. It’s been a long drive.
lines.369680624315346945: The motel, Walker. You were going to the motel. The Crimson Bear.
lines.369680624315346947: You still have the files on Eddie in the trunk of your car.
lines.369680624319541248: Yeah. Yeah, I still have them.
lines.369680624319541249: Focus. I’m paying you good money. Find him, Walker.
lines.369680624319541250: Yeah, I’ll find him. I’ll find Eddie Velvet. I promise.
lines.369680624323735553: I don't understand what's happening. There are things out here, horrible things...
lines.369680624323735554: Don't do this to me, Walker. The job. I need you to focus on the job.
lines.369680624323735555: There was a bar... I saw Eddie, he was with a girl.
lines.369680624327929856: There was something else... "A Ride to the stars."
lines.369680624327929858: Is there a cable car in town? I think Eddie and his girl were going up a mountain.
lines.369680624327929859: Okay. Look into it. You're doing good, Walker. You're on the right track.
lines.369680624332124160: Find out what you can. I want Velvet, that's all that matters.
lines.369680624340512768: I think he went up to the peak. It’s a little hard to explain… What’s happening here?
lines.369680624340512769: You’re doing great, Walker. You’re my eyes and ears. I trust you’re making the right calls. That’s why I hired you.
lines.369680624340512770: Yeah, but what does any of this mean?
lines.369680624340512771: Don’t worry about it. Just find Eddie for me, and you’ll be off to your paradise beach.
lines.369680624344707073: When the job is done. Did you forget? Palm trees, the endless blue ocean, sipping a Piña Colada?
lines.369680624344707075: You’ll have it made. Just go to the Peak, and bring me Eddie Velvet. All your troubles will melt away like a bad dream.
lines.369680624348901376: What have you found out, detective?
lines.369680624348901377: I checked out the sheriff's department. Eddie was a suspect in a missing person's case. There was an interview tape.
lines.369680624353095680: Nothing concrete... The deputy was a bit... Difficult to work with. But I think I'm making progress in getting up on the peak.
lines.369680624353095681: That should be your focus. Don't let yourself get distracted. Everything else is a sideshow. Keep me posted.
lines.369680624357289984: There’s someone else out here. Old guy, he seems serious.
